playing mistake-free golf. In the blink of an eye, it flipped. Los Angeles tied the match at the sixth, took the lead for the first time at No. 7 and then ripped off three consecutive eagles to take the title. Rose finished the job with an eagle at the first Singles hole, which was worth three points after Hammer throws from both teams.
